span.label: why a modest bandgap increase is worth a hard materials problem: the critical field goes as the square of the bandgap and the Baliga FOM as its cube, so GaN to AlN is 1.8x in bandgap and about 34x in figure of merit
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: why doping gets harder as the gap widens - Quotation withheld, so free carriers first rise with dopant concentration and then fall
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a second doping obstacle: localized valence-band states, notably from first-row elements such as oxygen, let a hole trap itself in its own lattice distortion as a small polaron, suppressing mobility even where a shallow acceptor exists
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the fundamental obstacle to gate insulators: a dielectric with a large bandgap tends to have a low dielectric constant and vice versa, so the high-k insulator a UWBG MOSFET wants may not exist
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: new physics that only appears here - when the bandgap exceeds the electron affinity, a carrier must have kinetic energy above the affinity to impact-ionise, so it momentarily occupies vacuum states before doing so
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: why carrier confinement gets harder with a wider gap: the number of semiconductors and insulators with large enough band offsets DECREASES, and for AlN, BN and diamond few dielectrics are predicted to confine electrons at all
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: every one of the three leading UWBG materials is poor on at least one of the three metrics that matter: AlN and Ga2O3 cannot be usefully p-doped, and diamond substrates are small or defective
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the critical breakdown fields of AlN, BN, Ga2O3 and diamond - the property the whole case rests on - are yet to be accurately determined
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Ga2O3's thermal conductivity is one to two orders of magnitude below the other UWBG semiconductors, which the paper calls perhaps its single most serious weakness
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and p-type doping of Ga2O3 has never been reported, with hole self-trapping predicted from first principles
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AlN has no known acceptors at all, and only one postulated shallow donor
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: c-BN is the least mature of them, with substrates available only by the high-pressure high-temperature route
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the survey covers only the KNOWN applications, and the authors say plainly that the technology will create applications that do not yet exist
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: extracting a critical field from a working device is unreliable because edge terminations cause premature breakdown - and the higher the voltage the more likely that is, so the measurement gets harder exactly where it matters most
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: deep-level transient spectroscopy stops working on these materials because the traps are too deep and emission times too long - a standard characterisation technique defeated by the property under study

span.label: bandgap → dielectric constant
span.note: AN INVERSE TRADE-OFF ACROSS MATERIALS, NOT A CAUSAL EFFECT WITHIN ONE. `any dielectric with a large bandgap will tend to have a low dielectric constant - and vice versa`. Nothing is being done to a bandgap to lower a permittivity; it is a regularity over the space of available materials, and it is the reason a high-k ultrawide-bandgap gate insulator may not exist. `causes ... reduces` would assert a mechanism the paper does not claim, and there is no `trades-off-against` or `correlates-with` type
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AlN → acceptors
span.note: A MATERIAL DEFINED HERE BY WHAT IT LACKS. `no known acceptors available and sulfur postulated as the only likely shallow donor` - this is the single fact that keeps AlN out of bipolar devices, and every one of the eight relation types asserts that something HOLDS. The nearest available edge, `causes ... eliminates`, says AlN does something to acceptors; what is true is that none has been found
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: maturity → Ga2O3
span.note: A JUDGEMENT ABOUT A THING, MADE BY THE PAPER, AND LABELLED AS ONE. `an informal assessment of the maturity level`, resolving to Mature or Immature over three named sub-criteria. This is the relation type this corpus most needs and does not have - an ASSESSMENT edge, carrying who judged, on what criteria, and how firmly. Every one of our eight types says something about the world; none says something about an appraisal of the world
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: maturity assessment - THE PAPER CALLS ITS OWN JUDGEMENT LAYER INFORMAL, IN THE SENTENCE THAT INTRODUCES IT. It is a Mature/Immature verdict resting on three named sub-criteria - doping, volume/cost, substrate size and availability - each reported separately in its own table row. A score whose inputs are printed beside it is a score a reader can disagree with
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: figure of merit - THERE IS NO SINGLE ONE, AND WHICH APPLIES DEPENDS ON THE APPLICATION. The Baliga FOM is for low-frequency unipolar vertical power switches; for high-frequency high-power work the Johnson FOM is `more appropriate`. A material's rank changes with the question, so a table of FOMs is a table of conditional rankings
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: critical electric field, in the properties table - PROJECTED, NOT MEASURED. The values for AlN, Ga2O3, c-BN and diamond are calculated from GaN's experimentally derived field, and to compare them fairly the authors assume the SAME hypothetical device for all: a non-punched-through p+/n diode at a stated donor concentration. A number in a properties column that is a model output with a device baked into it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: intrinsic carrier concentration, for an ultrawide-bandgap material - A NUMBER FERMI-DIRAC STATISTICS PRODUCE THAT IS NOT A QUANTITY. Around 10^-10 cm^-3, which the authors say `has no direct physical meaning`, because the statistics assume carriers come from the high-energy tail of a thermal distribution and that assumption fails several electron-volts from a band edge. It still enters TCAD models and destabilises them
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: immature - THE PAPER'S VERDICT ON EVERY UWBG MATERIAL INCLUDING THE ONES IT CHAMPIONS, and it is a comparative claim rather than a criticism: the field is placed where GaN and SiC were in the 1980s. Each of the three leading materials is poor on at least one of the three metrics, and the paper says which
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: material property, of the kind tabulated in reviews - NOT NECESSARILY STABLE. This paper re-derived them because values in common use were measured decades ago on material that would now be called highly defective. GaN turned out to have at least FIVE different permittivity sets in circulation, and AlN's bandgap was moved from 6.2 to 6.0 eV in 2010 by a better measurement. A constant in a table has a date and a method behind it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: critiques → the material property values in common use across the semiconductor literature, including for GaN, many measured decades ago on highly defective material
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.note: the paper does not adjudicate between the five on theoretical grounds - it re-searches the literature and takes new AlN measurements, and calls establishing the best values an important outcome OF THIS STUDY rather than a side note
